responsibility: Provides the core target configuration header for the FR30 port, defining the architecture’s compile-time properties and backend macros. It specifies data layout and endianness, C type sizes, register numbering and fixed/call-used conventions, stack and frame conventions, addressing and section/assembler syntax, calling-sequence details, register classes and elimination relationships, and hooks/macros that connect generic GCC code generation to FR30-specific ABI and assembly rules.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the FR30 port’s configuration header, supplying preprocessor macros for ABI, register layout, data layout, assembler syntax, and driver specs that the .cc implementation and .md patterns rely on, rather than containing the executable hook code, RTL instruction definitions, or command-line option declarations.
